module: Simulates AI competitors for the leaderboard of a rally special stage or loop. The competitors' parameters (skill, consistency, risk, name) and the model coefficients are read from gameplay/rally/aiCompetitorsConfig.json when the module loads. For each competitor, a result (safe, push, minor_incident, major_incident, dnf) is drawn at random, then a time is sampled from a normal distribution anchored on a reference time (by default the 'silverTime' medal). The module also formats the times and builds the rows of the table shown in the UI.
notes: Times are in seconds; the texts are formatted 'h:mm:ss.d' / 'm:ss.d' / 's.d' (a single tenth digit, rounded to 0.1 s).
The results are random (math.random): each call to computeLeaderboard gives a different ranking for the AIs.
Each incident (minor: 1 to 2, major: 2 to 5) adds 5 s to a competitor's time; a DNF gives a nil time.
In multi-stage, a DNF on one special stage forces the DNF on all following ones; the sort first places those with the fewest DNF columns.
If aiCompetitorsConfig.json is not found, PARAMS is nil: the competitor list is empty but the density/weight functions (which use PARAMS) would raise an error if paramTable is not provided.
The 'general' sub-object of the config JSON is flattened into the parameter table; the competitor list is read from 'competitors' (or 'drivers').

referenceStarKey.desc: Key of the medal time used as the pace reference for the simulated competitors. Is 'silverTime' by default; getReferenceTime reads it from missionTypeData.

getReferenceTime.desc: Returns the reference time (medal designated by referenceStarKey) of a mission, or nil if it is absent or not strictly positive.

missionTypeData.desc: Mission type data containing for example silverTime.

computeMixtureWeights.desc: Computes the normalized weights of the 5 possible results (safe, push, minor_incident, major_incident, dnf) for a given skill and risk level. Uses a fixed consistency of 0.5 (with no effect on the weights).

paramTable.desc: Model coefficients (safe_weight_base, push_weight_floor, etc.); nil = those of the config file.

skill.desc: Competitor skill (0 to 1 expected, inferred from code).

risk.desc: Risk propensity (0 to 1 expected, inferred from code).

returns.desc: 5 weights summing to 1, in the order safe, push, minor_incident, major_incident, dnf.

mixtureDensityTimes.desc: Computes the density of the Gaussian mixture of finish times (preview for the editor). Uses the same weights and means/standard deviations as the sampling; the DNF has no density.

consistency.desc: Consistency (1 = very consistent: reduced standard deviation).

timeLo.desc: Lower bound of the time axis.

timeHi.desc: Upper bound of the time axis.

precomputedWeights.desc: Weights already computed, to avoid recomputing them.

returns.desc: {times, mixture, weights, components (5 density arrays per result), sampleCount}.

applyOfficialPlayerTotalSeconds.desc: Overwrites the player row's total time with the official total from the rally event log (time of all special stages + penalties). In multi-stage updates finalTime/finalDnf, in single stage time/dnf; the deltas are not recomputed.

leaderboard.desc: Result of computeLeaderboard (must have rows and playerRowIndex).

computeLeaderboard.desc: Builds the player + AI competitors ranking. With two numbers: a single special stage. With two arrays of the same length (>= 1): several special stages (loop). Returns {rows = {}} if the inputs are invalid.

playerTimeOrTimes.desc: Player time (or list of times per special stage).

silverTimeOrTimes.desc: Reference (silver) time of the special stage, or list per special stage; must be > 0.

playerName.desc: Display name; nil = 'Player' with translation key missions.aiCompetitorsLeaderboard.player.

playerFinalSortSecs.desc: Official total (special stages + penalties) used to rank the player.

returns.desc: {rows, playerRowIndex}; in multi: also multiStage=true and stageCount, rows with stageCells/finalTime/finalDnf; in single: rows with time/delta/deltaVsLeader/deltaVsAhead/dnf.
